title: Innoko National Wildlife Refuge
summary: The Innoko National Wildlife Refuge, traditional homelands of the Koyukon Athabascan people, was established by the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. ANILCA established the refuge in two units totaling 4.6 million acres.
